lines.say: You pressed minus nine. Someone down there has been living your life.
Your doormat. Your door. You knock. You open it yourself.
Same flat. Same bed. But everything is grey. And a man in grey is eating your breakfast.
He works two jobs. Night shifts. His payslips have your name on them.
Every month he pays your rent. That's why it was always so cheap.
He wants to swap back. Would you? Write it in the comments.
